# Local File History V1 fixture

This is the V1 on-disk manifest and payload layout emitted by the initial
local-file journal implementation in commit `0a1868b3863bdee93b4e1e15b6bc8beed5929268`
(`Execute local files through Electron relay`, 2026-07-10), before the later
Writer live-review and D448 `apply_patch` journal integrations.

`__WORKSPACE_ROOT__` is replaced only after the fixture is copied into a
temporary test directory; the persisted layout remains `manifest.json` plus
`payloads/<entry-id>/{pre,post}.bin`. The payload SHA-256 values and byte sizes
in `manifest.json` are for the committed fixture bytes, not generated by the
current journal writer during the test.
